# Whole-Line Downgrade Run Record｜整线降级运行记录

## Scope｜范围

This is a minimal, redacted package copy of a fixed desktop rule calculation. It is not a real retest or a field event.

这是固定桌面规则演算的最小脱敏随包副本，不是真实复测或现场事件。

## Fixed calculation｜固定演算

| Field｜字段 | Recorded value｜记录值 |
|---|---|
| Trigger｜触发条件 | Any mechanism card fails retesting.｜任一机制卡复测不过。 |
| Example trigger used in the desktop calculation｜桌面演算使用的示例触发 | M01 fails retesting.｜M01 复测不过。 |
| Line action｜整线动作 | Downgrade the passport level for the entire Discovery Line by one level.｜整条发现线的护照等级降回上一级。 |
| Partial patch｜局部补丁 | Not allowed; the weakest card cannot be patched in isolation.｜不允许；不能只补最差一卡。 |
| Field run｜现场运行 | No｜否 |

## Restoration boundary｜恢复边界

The downgrade rule does not itself perform restoration. The proposal requires the AI layer to go dark, the prior state and non-AI timetable to return, and people to take over the next decision. Responsible person, stop authority, retest date, and restoration cost remain UNKNOWN until duly empowered actors confirm them.

降级规则本身不执行恢复。方案要求 AI 层熄灭，恢复原状和非 AI 时刻表，再由人接手决定下一步；责任人、叫停人、复测日和恢复费用在有权主体确认前均保持 UNKNOWN。
verification_boundary: Minimal redacted desktop record only; not field evidence, approval, authorization, implementation, or independently rerunnable code.
